exceptions.name: seed_demo_blog_posts
exceptions.reason: Legacy seed targets the retired fixed demo-store UUID. That tenant does not exist in production, so applying this seed would violate its store foreign key.

exceptions.name: storefront_manual_payment_replay_guard
exceptions.reason: Commerce hardening branch: exactly-once storefront manual payment reference claims are ready for regression validation before production rollout.

exceptions.name: scope_coupon_codes_per_store
exceptions.reason: Commerce hardening branch: replaces accidental platform-global coupon code uniqueness with the canonical per-store identity contract.

exceptions.name: bound_cart_item_quantity
exceptions.reason: Commerce hardening branch: persists the existing 1..99 checkout line quantity contract on authenticated cart rows.

exceptions.name: lock_direct_order_mutations
exceptions.reason: Commerce hardening branch: removes direct client order mutation grants/policies so governed server routes remain lifecycle authority.

exceptions.name: enforce_commerce_numeric_bounds
exceptions.reason: Commerce hardening branch: moves existing product/coupon numeric UI and checkout bounds into database constraints.

exceptions.name: product_link_tenant_consistency
exceptions.reason: Commerce hardening branch: enforces store/product composite identity for cart, stock-notification, and product-QA rows.

exceptions.name: tenant_owned_reference_consistency
exceptions.reason: Commerce hardening branch: enforces same-store order/product references for shipments, revenue events, and analytics while preserving existing delete semantics.

exceptions.name: commerce_tenant_graph_consistency
exceptions.reason: Commerce hardening branch: closes remaining cross-store courier, recovery, and category hierarchy references with composite tenant keys.

exceptions.name: r4_section_studio_variant_options
exceptions.reason: Frozen R4 Section Studio migration is present in the frozen storefront baseline but has not yet been applied to production; keep it explicit until coordinated R4 rollout and ledger refresh.

exceptions.name: harden_return_refund_recordkeeping
exceptions.reason: Commerce hardening branch: keeps return/refund operations as truthful manual recordkeeping until provider/store-credit settlement authority exists.

exceptions.name: lock_cart_recovery_message_mutations
exceptions.reason: Commerce hardening branch: removes direct client mutation authority from the cart-recovery delivery ledger so only governed server queue/processor paths can author outreach truth.

exceptions.name: dedupe_cart_recovery_scheduled_touches
exceptions.reason: Commerce hardening branch: gives each scheduled recovery touch a durable store/lead/time identity so concurrent authorized queue requests cannot enqueue duplicate outreach.
